model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, 500 trees, random_state=42) on all 8 features
notes: Removed 307 near-duplicate rows (same six integer measurements, BMI within 0.3, pedigree within 0.02, same outcome) from 921 rows, leaving 614; then a stratified 80/20 split (seed 42) was used and accuracy is measured on the 123-row test set.
